title: FC 8001: General
officialText:
8001.1 Scope.

This chapter lists the standards that are referenced in this code.

8001.2 Edition.

The edition of each standard referenced in this code shall be as indicated by the standard reference number.

8001.3 Relationship with code and rules.

The application of the referenced standards and their relationship with the provisions of this code and the rules shall be as set forth in FC 102.6.
